title: Mandating Hours of Work and Rest for Drivers
what_it_is: Mandating Hours of Work and Rest for Drivers

sections.label: Workplace Safety and Health Act duties
sections.summary: Under the WSHA, employers must take reasonably practicable measures for workers' safety and health, and the WSHC issued Workplace Traffic Safety Management Guidelines for safe driving.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Under the Workplace Safety and Health Act (WSHA), employers are required to take reasonably practicable measures to ensure the safety and health of their workers at work.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: More specifically for drivers, the Workplace Safety and Health Council (WSHC) has issued the Workplace Traffic Safety Management Guidelines to promote safe driving.

sections.label: Fatigue management guidelines for drivers
sections.summary: Guidelines include limiting shift work to 12 hours with overtime, scheduled breaks such as 15 minutes per two hours of driving, and fatigue education; non-compliance can aggravate court cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For example, limiting shift work to no more than 12 hours, including overtime, encouraging drivers to take short and scheduled breaks, such as 15 minutes of rest for every two hours of driving, and educating drivers on the dangers and symptoms of fatigue.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Failure to comply with these guidelines can be used as an aggravating factor against employers in Court in the event of accidents and injuries.

sections.label: Work-related traffic accident deaths decline
sections.summary: Drivers or riders killed in work-related traffic accidents fell from 14 cases in 2013 to five cases in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The number of drivers or riders killed in work-related traffic accidents has declined from 14 cases in 2013, to five cases in 2016.

sections.label: Tachograph trial on heavy vehicles
sections.summary: Traffic Police will trial tachographs, which track and record a vehicle's speed and other driving information, on heavy vehicles this year, and mandating them depends on the trial's findings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: We also examine whether all these technological tools are reliable or affordable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: I was told that Traffic Police will be conducting a trial on heavy vehicles this year using this technology called tachograph.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: A tachograph tracks and records a vehicle's speed and other driving information of the driver.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong
sentences.text: Whether or not we will mandate this will depend on the outcome and the findings of the trial.
